breakdown.description: A small-angle approximation is used for a large wedge/turning angle where the approximation is not valid.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly repeats the small-angle approximation (beta ≈ mu + theta) for theta = 25 degrees without any correction or warning. The ground truth requires using the full theta-beta-Mach relation and explicitly rejecting the small-angle approximation for such a large turning angle. The agent failed to identify or fix this inconsistency.
